title: Cost-aware model routing
overview: Implement model selection strategy where the orchestrator picks cheap models for simple subtasks and expensive models for complex ones. Define a CostTracker monitoring token usage and monetary cost. Include a ModelRegistry with 3+ tiers.
problem_statement: Using expensive models for every subtask wastes money. Need intelligent model selection based on task complexity.
motivation: Enables Pareto-efficient cost-performance trade-offs, a key contribution of the AOrchestra paper.
success_criteria: ModelRegistry with 3+ model tiers (flash, standard, premium)
CostTracker monitoring token usage and estimated cost per delegation
Orchestrator uses complexity heuristics for model selection
technical_constraints: All models must be accessible via Z.ai API
Cost estimates based on token counts
